propositions.text: For grid-delivered purchased electricity, location-based accounting uses the average emissions profile of the relevant electricity grid.
qualifications: This explanation excludes direct-line and on-site generation cases.

propositions.text: Market-based accounting reflects electricity procurement arrangements; a contract or certificate does not automatically qualify its factor for use.
qualifications: Contractual evidence and applicable quality criteria require review. This pilot cannot validate a purchase or select a factor.

propositions.text: EPA recommends reporting separately labeled location-based and market-based Scope 2 totals.
qualifications: This is U.S.-focused inventory guidance, not a determination of legal reporting duties or a universal rule for every market.

propositions.text: Relevant electricity evidence depends on facility location, reporting year, and supplier or contractual coverage.
qualifications: This is a bounded synthesis for requesting context, not a sufficient checklist for selecting a factor.

propositions.text: Under the GHG Protocol guidance, operations in markets offering product- or supplier-specific contractual data trigger dual reporting.
qualifications: If this applies anywhere in a multi-region inventory, the market-based total covers the whole inventory, with the specified fallback where necessary. Do not infer that a company can opt out simply because it bought no certificates. The guidance also describes location-only conditions.

propositions.text: A market-based result allocates emissions through qualifying contractual evidence; it does not necessarily represent the emissions caused by that buyer’s electricity consumption.
qualifications: Do not equate an inventory allocation with proof of avoided grid emissions.

propositions.text: The October 2025 Scope 2 consultation is proposed revision material. Its consultation closed in January 2026; the publisher says existing guidance continues until it communicates otherwise.
qualifications: Status checked September 8, 2026. This is publisher status, not regulator adoption; no new effective standard is inferred from a draft.

product_policy.missing_context_behavior: Request relevant facts and disclose that this pilot cannot select numeric factors even when those facts are supplied.
product_policy.unsupported_behavior: Explain the release coverage limit; do not calculate, file, invent factor values or imply legal applicability.
product_policy.draft_behavior: Keep proposals separate; if status evidence is withheld, stale or unreleased, report stale_or_conflicting rather than answer from it.
product_policy.attribution: Display canonical primary source and exact locator for every rendered proposition.
